title: Lunar layers are inverted like an excavation site

tellings.quote: uh lower sediment layers on the moon actually are newer than higher sediment layers. So it's the exact inverse and it actually pattern matches to an excavation site.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that on the Moon the lower layers of material are actually newer than the layers above them, the reverse of what you would normally expect. He says this pattern matches an excavation site, where dug-up material gets piled on top. If true, it would hint that someone once dug into the Moon.
